parsed.g: Find the product SKUs in the most recent cancelled orders of the customer who has the most cancellations in history
P_t: Navigated to the Sales > Orders page
Opened the Filters panel on the Orders page
Identified that order #000000180 for Samantha Jones is a Cancelled order (Jun 13, 2022)
Viewed order #000000180 details and found it contains products: Karmen Yoga Pant (SKU: WP01-28-Black) and Summit Watch (SKU: 24-MG03)
Navigated to the Customers list page
R_t: Successfully apply the 'Canceled' status filter on the Orders page and click 'Apply Filters'
Review all cancelled orders to count cancellations per customer and identify the customer with the most cancellations
Find the most recent cancelled order(s) for that customer
Extract all product SKUs from those most recent cancelled orders
parsed.e_t: The agent is currently on the Magento Admin Dashboard page (http://172.185.52.29:7780/admin/admin/dashboard/). The Last Orders section shows Sarah Miller, Grace Nguyen, Matt Baker, Lily Potter, and Ava Brown. The SALES menu is not expanded. No filters are currently applied.
C: Must identify the customer with the MOST cancellations across all history before determining which orders to look at
Must look at the most RECENT cancelled orders (plural - there may be multiple on the same date) for that customer
Must report product SKUs, not product names

F_t.cause: The agent repeatedly opened the Status dropdown and clicked the 'Canceled' option, but never followed up by clicking 'Apply Filters'. Each time, the page navigated away or the filter was not applied, as evidenced by the orders table still showing 308 records and mixed statuses (Canceled, Complete) in subsequent observations.
